identities.experiment: re-floor attention_q on real activations; does the weight-space floor equalise or widen the error it should preserve?
identities.machine: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GiB
identities.device: CPU device throughout -- the operator's mlx_boot.py holds the GPU and a materialization timed out mid-run, so per S032 s24 the whole sweep moved to the CPU rather than contending. Relative error and bit counts are device-independent, so no number changes.
identities.model: Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B, Falcon-H1-7B -- layer-0 q_proj, real bf16 lake weights
identities.representation: grouped absmax, bits x group over 12 settings, complete bpw including the f16 scale amortised over the group

kernel.reason: no kernel; a representation sweep in numpy

result.DOING_THE_THING_THE_PREVIOUS_RECEIPT_SAI: ACCELERATOR_ACTIVATION_VS_WEIGHT_SPACE closed with 'NO CORRECTED BUDGET IS CLAIMED: no re-floored setting was measured and nothing here says what attention_q SHOULD cost'. This measures it, and the strongest result is one I did not set out to get.
result.THE_CONFOUND_FREE_HEADLINE: Every number here is a WITHIN-SPECIMEN delta -- same weights, same activations, only the representation setting moves -- so the cross-architecture incommensurability the previous receipt named DOES NOT APPLY TO IT. Moving each specimen from a single flat setting (q4_g64) to ITS OWN weight-space floor changes its real-activation error MONOTONICALLY BY RANK: the best specimen IMPROVES 14.21%, the second is EXACTLY UNCHANGED (its floor already is g64), the third WORSENS 10.43% and the fourth WORSENS 9.63%. THE PROCEDURE IMPROVES THE ALREADY-GOOD AND DEGRADES THE ALREADY-BAD.
result.P1_CONFIRMED_THE_PROCEDURE_WIDENS_WHAT_I: Spread of real-activation error across the four specimens at their OWN floors is 0.043958 against 0.032994 at one flat setting for everybody -- 1.33x WIDER. The floor procedure's stated logic is that each specimen reaches a comparable COSINE at its own floor; comparable cosine delivers a WIDER activation spread than doing nothing at all. That is a statement about the procedure's internal consistency, not a ranking of architectures.
result.AT_THEIR_ASSIGNED_FLOORS_THE_RANGE_IS_2_: 0.028034 / 0.033354 / 0.062415 / 0.071992 -- a 2.57x range in the very quantity the representation exists to preserve, produced by a procedure whose purpose is to put every specimen at an equivalent fidelity.
result.THE_REALLOCATION_IS_FULLY_INVERTED_AND_I: At every one of five bars (0.02-0.06) the two Qwen specimens need the FEWEST bits and Kimi-VL and Falcon-H1 need the MOST. The weight-space floor says the exact opposite: Qwen3-30B 4.500, Qwen3-VL 4.250, Kimi-VL 4.125, Falcon-H1 4.125. At a 0.04 bar the activation floor is 4.125 / 4.125 / 5.125 / 5.125 -- the specimen the procedure under-provisions at its cheapest 4-bit option needs A FULL BIT MORE.
result.P2_REFUTED_IN_PART_AND_I_DO_NOT_GET_TO_Q: I pre-registered that the re-floored ORDERING would be STABLE across bars, and said that if it flipped the method does not define a budget and I must say so. IT FLIPS. The COARSE grouping is stable at all five bars -- both Qwen below both of {Kimi, Falcon} every time -- but the KIMI-vs-FALCON internal order swaps at 2 of 5 bars. So the DIRECTION of the reallocation is robust and NO PRECISE PER-SPECIMEN BUDGET IS CLAIMED for that pair. My own falsifier fired and the consequence is that the corrected budget this receipt set out to produce is NOT PUBLISHED.
result.P3_CONFIRMED_THE_SWEEP_CAN_DETECT_A_DEAD: bits=1 is the deletion control -- bound = 2^(bits-1)-1 is ZERO so every weight quantises to zero -- and it reads relative error EXACTLY 1.0000 on all four specimens. A sweep where a deleted tensor scored well would be measuring nothing.
result.tests: no new tests; no shipped code path changed by this measurement

claim_boundary: ONE ORGAN (attention q_proj), ONE LAYER, ONE PROJECTION per specimen, activations from RMSNorm(embed[ids]) at position 0 -- the exact input that projection sees, and not a deeper activation, which a one-layer cut could not produce honestly anyway. THE WITHIN-SPECIMEN DELTAS ARE CONFOUND-FREE; the SPREAD comparison and the bar-based reflooring still compare four different functions, which is exactly why P2 was written and exactly why its partial refutation is reported rather than a per-specimen budget. NO CORRECTED BUDGET IS PUBLISHED and no floor is changed in any tool -- this measures what the existing procedure does, not what should replace it, and choosing a replacement needs a bar somebody can defend on grounds this measurement does not supply. The 2.57x range and the 1.33x spread widening are properties of THESE four specimens at THIS organ; the organ-floor receipt already measured that organ ranking does not transfer across architectures, so neither should this. Nothing timed, no kernel changed, no capability scored, no model generated from. BENCH_STATE CONTENDED.
